Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
Then Yahweh’s angel replied, “O Yahweh of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of…
They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on…

translations.web: Will you hold yourself back for these things, Yahweh? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?
translations.bsb: After all this, O LORD, will You restrain Yourself? Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?
translations.kjv: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
translations.asv: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O Jehovah? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
